transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I need to get our schedule finalized and published, but before I can do that, I need sign-off from both maintenance and production. Here's the situation: Line 4 is scheduled for its planned servo overhaul before the next production cycle, and we have a customer shipment using the same product due Monday morning. The good news is Line 3 can produce the same product while Line 4 is unavailable. I'd like to hear from maintenance on the overhaul timeline and from production on whether Line 3 can cover the shipment demand. Once I have both sign-offs, I'll publish the schedule.
